source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Discussion to Improve Teamwork (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: In tajurbat par guftagu talaba ko ghaltiyon se seekhne aur behtar team player banne mein madad deti hai. Reflection group members mein izzat aur samajh bhi barhata hai. Waqt ke saath yeh aadat mazboot teamwork aur zyada kamyab collaboration ki taraf le jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Tajurbat par guftagu (discussion) se students ko kya faida hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh ghaltiyon se seekhte aur behtar team players bante hain; group members mein izzat aur samajh barhti hai, aur waqt ke saath teamwork mazboot hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Poore section 9.3 ka jaiza: Aap ke chaar ke group ko online presentation banani hai. Batayein ke kirdaron, kaam ki fehrist aur mushtarka dastavez se kaam kaise munazzam karenge.
blocks.explanation: Har rukn ko kirdar dein (researcher, likhne wala, designer, pesh karne wala); kaam, zimmedar aur deadlines mushtarka checklist mein; slides aik mushtarka file mein jis ki edit rasai sirf team ko; progress dekhne ke liye mukhtasar video meeting; aur aakhir mein mil kar ghaur ke kya behtar ho.

items: Discussion: ghaltiyon se seekhna; izzat, samajh aur mazboot teamwork.
